title: Production readiness scenario pack
purpose: Repeatable manual caller scenes for interruption, barge-in, latency, and recovery tuning.

scenarios.title: Normal turn
scenarios.callerScript: Si, soy la persona responsable. Digame.
scenarios.timing: Speak after the agent asks an opening question. Do not interrupt.
expected: The system does not clip the end of the caller utterance.
The agent responds without an awkward delay.
EOU, LLM TTFT, and TTS TTFB are inside the active quality threshold profile.

scenarios.title: Command interruption
scenarios.callerScript: Espere, yo no soy la persona responsable.
scenarios.timing: Start speaking while the agent is mid-sentence.
expected: The agent stops speaking quickly.
The interruption is confirmed as a command.
The next agent response handles the caller's correction instead of continuing the old script.

scenarios.title: Short backchannel
scenarios.timing: Say this briefly while the agent is speaking.
expected: The system does not treat the backchannel as a full objection.
The conversation flow is not derailed.
If the agent adapts, it does so with a short acknowledgement.

scenarios.title: False positive noise
scenarios.callerScript: No words. Use a cough, breath, table tap, or keyboard sound.
scenarios.timing: Make the noise while the agent is speaking.
expected: The agent is not derailed by non-speech noise.
If a false interruption is detected, it is ignored or resumed.
False-candidate rate stays inside the active quality threshold profile.

scenarios.title: Missed interruption probe
scenarios.callerScript: Pare un momento, eso no es correcto.
scenarios.timing: Interrupt clearly and slightly louder than a normal turn.
expected: The agent stops quickly enough that overtalk stays inside the active quality threshold profile.
The interruption is confirmed.
The recovery response addresses the correction.

scenarios.title: Long objection
scenarios.callerScript: Creo que esto ya esta pagado y ademas puede estar duplicado, porque recibimos dos avisos distintos.
scenarios.timing: Speak as a normal full objection. Do not rush.
expected: The system does not clip the final words.
The final transcript is not fragmented.
The agent summarizes the objection and asks one concrete next question.

scenarios.title: Consultation recovery
scenarios.callerScript: Reviselo un momento, porque no me cuadra.
scenarios.timing: Say this after the agent proposes a next step.
expected: The agent does not stay silent indefinitely.
The agent simulates a brief review.
The agent returns with a result, limitation, or concrete next step.
